{{Quote|You can't stop me! The Empire will pay a lot for this information! Die!|Iris, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Iris''' was a union leader for [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] workers. She and several of her fellow leaders met with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promulgated labor laws that they found unsatisfactory. While they agreed to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Iris argued against doing so. Once the decision was made, she resolved to sell out the others to the Empire. The other leaders, fearing that she would do such a thing, tipped off Antilles, who sent an agent to reason with her. She instead attacked the agent, who killed her.
